name: The Three Wise Witches
source:
A new son of God is set to be born every 2000 years. Seeing how the original three wise men brought petty gifts to him like gold and myrrh, angel Nathaniel decides to summon three witches this time around to help him out with magic!

[From [url=https://tempestdahlia.itch.io/the-three-wise-witches]Itch.io[/url]]
